description: Declared foreground/background pairings for the Zeros token palette, with WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios and reviewed supplemental/boundary floors in BOTH themes. Asserted by apps/desktop/src/renderer/shared/theme/__tests__/contrast-contract.test.ts. A pairing that is not listed here is not a sanctioned combination.

text.why: WCAG 1.4.3 AA for normal-size text; Zeros chrome text is 10–14px, never 'large'.

graphic.why: WCAG 1.4.11: icons, status dots, and control boundaries that carry meaning.

focus.why: WCAG 1.4.11 / 2.4.11: an opaque focus indicator against every surface it can sit on.

supplemental.why: Reviewed below-AA floor for labels drawn over translucent washes (merge-conflict marker bands). Resting metadata is fg3, which meets AA.

boundary.why: Control outlines must stay perceptible on every surface controls sit on: a perceptibility floor, not a WCAG claim. bg2 is checked for the border4 hover step only. Resting outlines are subtle by reviewed design, below WCAG 1.4.11’s 3:1; focus is the strong cue.

boundary-hover.why: Hover/open outlines must read stronger on every control surface: a perceptibility floor, not a WCAG claim. bg2 is excluded because controls do not sit on the user-message bubble.

pairs.why: Workspace link pill labels at rest and hover; Light uses a stronger fill on the bg2 composer.
Opaque 1px accent focus edge on Local link pills.
Three text tiers meet AA at rest on every resting surface.
Hovered or selected rows lift fg3 to fg2; fg3 is never the resting tier on a hover fill.
Standalone status text and counts (+N / −N) on app surfaces, including hovered rows and buttons.
Text on a tinted container uses the family -on-bg.
The check, radio dot and switch knob drawn on the accent fill.
Chat notices and Zeros' own messages: body text, actions and links on the blue wash.
The 1px accent border that marks keyboard focus and checked controls on every surface.

Text over code-editor search-match washes (35% match, 55% selected match). Editor text uses the syntax theme foreground, which sits at the fg1 end of the ladder; syntax token colors are a separate system.
Solid destructive fills; hover is 90% opacity of the same fill.
Solid Accept current change fills on a merge conflict, at rest and on hover.
Solid Accept incoming change fills on a merge conflict, at rest and on hover.
Solid Accept both fills on a merge conflict, at rest and on hover.
The (Current change) and (Incoming change) labels (fg2) on a conflict's marker bands, at the dark bands' alphas (0.26 and 0.34). Light's incoming band is 0.26, so 0.34 is the stricter check there.
Filled-button hover: the whole control at 90% opacity over the surface it sits on (page, raised group or dialog), label and fill together.

ladders.why: Each foreground tier is at least 15% less contrast than the one above it, in both themes (three tiers).
The hover/open control outline must have at least 15% more contrast than its resting outline on bg2.

exempt.why: Decorative surface separators; never the only cue for a control or state. Control outlines border3/4 have their own reviewed perceptibility floors.
Tinted/grouping washes; meaning is carried by their text and icons.
A scroll-position hint, shown only while its scroller is hovered or scrolled and never the only way to scroll. Faint by the owner's choice (2026-11-09): #222 in Dark, #EAEAEA in Light.
